theater: 古巴聖地牙哥與馬尼拉灣

battle.name: 美西戰爭
battle.theater: 古巴聖地牙哥與馬尼拉灣
battle.brief: 一八九八年四月二十五日美國對西班牙宣戰，戰火燒到古巴聖地牙哥、馬尼拉灣同波多黎各。西班牙守軍用毛瑟一八九三年式後膛步槍據守山頭，美軍仍有部隊配雷管一八七三年式春田單發槍，射速慢一半。七月三日聖地牙哥海戰西班牙艦隊全滅，十七日守軍投降，十二月《巴黎條約》割讓菲律賓與關島。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 美西戰爭是美國連同古巴革命軍、菲律賓革命黨人，對西班牙帝國及其加勒比與太平洋殖民地的一場戰爭。美國方面由總統威廉·麥金利主持，國務卿約翰·海掌理外交，陸軍部與海軍部各自直轄部隊：常備軍開戰時僅約二萬七千人，經國會立法擴充至十二萬五千人，另徵召十二萬五千名志願兵與各州民兵；古巴方面是馬克西莫·戈麥斯與卡利斯托·加西亞率領的解放軍，人數約三萬至五萬，以分散游擊為主；菲律賓方面是埃米利奧·阿吉納爾多與阿波里納里奧·馬比尼領導的革命軍，約四萬人。西班牙由國王阿方索十三世與攝政王瑪麗亞·克里斯蒂娜坐鎮馬德里，古巴都督府、菲律賓都督府與波多黎各都督府各有一套軍政系統：古巴由都督兼軍區司令統兵，下分正規軍團、民兵與地方分遣隊，全境兵力約二十七萬八千人；菲律賓約五萬一千人，波多黎各約一萬人。作戰體系上，美軍以軍團為基本單位，第五軍團負責古巴戰役，遠征菲律賓另組師團與旅團；海軍分北西洋分艦隊與亞洲分艦隊，全役美方動員三十萬人。
countriesEn: The Spanish-American War was fought by the United States, together with the Cuban Liberation Army and the Philippine revolutionaries, against the Spanish Empire and its Caribbean and Pacific colonies. On the American side President William McKinley directed the whole enterprise, with John Hay handling diplomacy and the War Department and the Navy Department each commanding their own forces: the Regular Army numbered only about 27,000 men at the outbreak, was legislated up to 125,000, and was joined by 125,000 volunteers and militia raised by the states. In Cuba the Liberation Army under Maximo Gomez and Calixto Garcia counted between thirty and fifty thousand men and fought mainly as dispersed guerrillas; in the Philippines the revolutionary army under Emilio Aguinaldo and Apolinario Mabini numbered about forty thousand. On the Spanish side King Alfonso XIII and the regent Queen Maria Cristina held court in Madrid, and the Captaincy General of Cuba, the Governor-General of the Philippines and the Governor-General of Puerto Rico each ran a separate military and civil system: in Cuba the captain-general commanded as military governor, with regular regiments, militia and local detachments beneath him and about 278,000 men on the island; the Philippines held some 51,000 and Puerto Rico about 10,000. Operationally the American army fought by corps, the Fifth Corps taking the Cuban campaign while separate divisions and brigades were formed for the Philippine expedition; at sea the North Atlantic Squadron and the Asiatic Squadron covered the war, and the United States mobilised 300,000 men in all.
people: 兩邊都有決定戰局的人物。麥金利在四月二十五日簽署宣戰，戰後仍要求國會正式批准，並倚重海軍部長約翰·D·朗、陸軍部長拉塞爾·阿爾傑與參謀長納爾遜·邁爾斯。第五軍團司令威廉·R·謝夫特年近七十且帶病，只能把指揮所設在山腳外兩英里的埃爾波索，前線實由騎兵師長約瑟夫·惠勒調度：攻聖胡安山是惠勒在前線指揮，勞頓的第二師攻卡內伊，肯特的第一師在中央，塞繆爾·薩姆納代管騎兵旅。第一志願騎兵團由倫納德·伍德招募，其副手西奧多·羅斯福升任團長，衝鋒之後升到中校與准將，返國競選紐約州州長得勝，後來做副總統，再入主白宮。海軍方面，威廉·T·桑普森統率北西洋分艦隊，溫菲爾德·斯科特·施萊率飛行中隊，戰後兩人為誰居首功爭論不休；喬治·杜威以亞洲分艦隊五月一日在馬尼拉灣取勝。炮兵那邊，約翰·H·帕克中尉把四挺加特林機槍拉到前線，羅斯福後來自認這支部隊功勞最大。西班牙一方，塞韋拉海軍上將帶加勒比分艦隊出海突圍，海軍參謀比亞米爾主張分散游擊反被否決；古巴軍總督瓦勒利安·韋勒在戰前推行集中營政策，戰時古巴總督是拉蒙·布蘭科，菲律賓總督是迭戈·德洛斯里奧斯；聖地牙哥守軍司令何塞·托拉爾，聖胡安山與卡內伊的指揮官是阿塞尼奧·利納雷斯與華金·瓦拉·德·雷。古巴義軍領袖何塞·馬蒂於五月十九日陣亡，戈麥斯與加西亞繼續在山區周旋；菲律賓的阿吉納爾多與馬比尼則成為日後對美作戰的領導人物。
peopleEn: Decisive figures appear on both sides. McKinley signed the declaration of war on 25 April, afterwards insisted that Congress ratify it, and relied on Secretary of the Navy John D. Long, Secretary of War Russell A. Alger and General Nelson A. Miles. The Fifth Corps was commanded by William R. Shafter, who was nearly seventy and already ill, so he set up his headquarters two miles from the foot of the heights at El Pozo and left the fighting to Major General Joseph Wheeler: Wheeler directed the attack on San Juan Hill from the front, Lawton's Second Division took El Caney, Kent's First Division attacked in the centre, and Samuel Sumner took temporary command of the cavalry brigade. The First Volunteer Cavalry was raised under Leonard Wood, and his deputy Theodore Roosevelt took over the regiment, was promoted to lieutenant colonel and then brigadier general, won the governorship of New York on his return, later became vice president and then president. In the navy Rear Admiral William T. Sampson commanded the North Atlantic Squadron and Commodore Winfield Scott Schley the Flying Squadron, and after the war the two argued bitterly over who deserved the credit; George Dewey won at Manila Bay on 1 May with the Asiatic Squadron. On the artillery side, Lieutenant John H. Parker brought four Gatling guns to the front, and Roosevelt later judged that detachment to have done more than any other single unit in the campaign. For Spain Admiral Pascual Cervera y Topete led the Caribbean squadron out of Santiago Bay in a desperate sortie, while naval officer Fernando Villaamil had urged the fleet to scatter and act on its own and was overruled; the captain-general of Cuba, Valeriano Weyler, had imposed the reconcentration policy before the war, and at the time of the war the military governor of Cuba was Ramon Blanco and the governor-general of the Philippines Diego de los Rios. Jose Toral commanded at Santiago, and Arsenio Linares and Joaquin Vara de Rey y Rubio held the San Juan and El Caney positions. Among the Cuban revolutionaries Jose Marti was killed in action on 19 May, while Gomez and Garcia kept the fight alive in the mountains; in the Philippines Aguinaldo and Mabini became the political leaders of the resistance that followed.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是法國一八四〇年代初推廣的雷管步槍，也就是一八四六年式與一八四七年式那一類步兵槍：底火配紙包藥包，米涅式彈頭令它在數百碼外仍然打得準。它沒有上過一八九八年任何一條戰線，卻是當年雙方步槍的設計母型——西班牙軍裝備的毛瑟一八九三年式後膛步槍，與美軍仍在使用的春田一八七三年式單發後膛槍，都是雷管世代的後裔，差別只在於前者已換成栓動與無煙藥，後者仍保留卡面那一代的射擊方式。戰場上真正開火的武器分四類。西班牙正規步兵配毛瑟一八九三年式七毫米步槍與八毫米舊式步槍，射速快到二十秒內可打八發；效忠西班牙的地方武裝用雷明頓轉栓式單發槍配黑火藥，追擊砲是普拉森西亞一八七四年式八厘米山砲；西班牙海軍裝四十一吋與五點五吋後膛砲，但多數後膛機件故障、鍋爐待修、船底附生物拖累航速，連主力艦的主砲都未裝好，只用木製假砲頂替。美軍主力是一八九二年式克拉格栓動步槍，配三〇四〇子彈；但第二麻州團與第二十四、第二十五兩個有色步兵團仍配春田一八七三年式單發後膛槍及四五七〇黑火藥，正是卡面那一代步槍的直系親屬。炮兵是三點二吋野戰砲，後膛線膛卻用布藥包黑火藥，無後座裝置，射程短、射速慢，每發都噴出大片黑煙。機槍有帕克中尉率領的四挺一八九五年式加特林機槍，配三〇步槍彈，另有捐給志願騎兵團的兩挺三腳架式一八九五年式柯特布郎寧機槍。運輸方面，志願騎兵團編制一千零六十人、一千二百五十八匹馬，但馬匹沒有隨團運到古巴，於是這支部隊在聖胡安山完全下馬作輕步兵使用；重砲、糧食與彈藥靠騡隊與沿海汽船轉運，戰艦添煤還得同西班牙爭奪近海煤源，俄勒岡號由舊金山繞合恩角航行一萬四千五百海里，用了六十六天才抵古巴。西班牙在聖胡安山稜線上只築稀疏的石砌胸牆與木柵堡壘，土木堡壘與機槍巢則由美軍工兵在圍城期間趕築。
kitsEn: The piece on the card is the French percussion rifle of the early 1840s, the type represented by the Model 1846 and Model 1847 infantry muskets: a percussion cap with paper cartridges and a Minie ball that kept the weapon accurate at several hundred yards. It never fought on any front in 1898, yet it is the design ancestor of the rifles on both sides: the Mauser Model 1893 bolt-action rifles of the Spanish army and the Springfield Model 1873 single-shot trapdoor rifles still carried by the Americans are both descendants of the percussion generation, differing only in that the former had moved on to bolt action and smokeless powder while the latter kept the firing characteristics of the card's own era. Four groups of weapons actually opened fire on the battlefield. Spanish regular infantry carried the Mauser Model 1893 in seven millimetre Mauser and older eight millimetre Mausers, fast enough to fire eight rounds in twenty seconds; the Spanish loyalist auxiliaries used Remington rolling block single-shot rifles with black powder, and their supporting guns were the Plasencia Model 1874 eighty millimetre mountain howitzers; the Spanish navy mounted eleven inch and five and a half inch breech-loading guns, but many of the breech mechanisms were faulty, the boilers needed repair and fouling dragged at the ships' speed, and even the battleships carried wooden dummy guns where their main battery should have been. The American main armament was the Model 1892 Krag bolt-action rifle chambered in .30-40, but the 2nd Massachusetts and the 24th and 25th Colored Infantry were still armed with Springfield Model 1873 single-shot trapdoor rifles using .45-70 black powder, the direct kin of the card's generation. The field artillery was the 3.2 inch gun, a breech-loading rifled piece firing black powder charges from cloth bags with no recoil system, short in range and slow in rate of fire, and each discharge laid down a bank of black smoke. The machine guns were the four Model 1895 Gatling guns under Lieutenant Parker, firing .30 Army ammunition, together with two tripod-mounted Model 1895 Colt-Browning guns presented to the volunteer cavalry. In the transport column the First Volunteer Cavalry was organised with 1,060 soldiers and 1,258 horses, but the horses were never shipped to Cuba, so the regiment fought the battle of San Juan Hill entirely dismounted as light infantry; heavy guns, food and ammunition went forward by mule train and coastal steamer, the warships fought for coal against Spanish sources nearby, and the battleship Oregon needed sixty-six days to sail fourteen thousand five hundred nautical miles from San Francisco around Cape Horn to reach Cuba. The Spanish had only thin stone breastworks and wooden stockades along the crest of San Juan Hill, while the Americans threw up timber blockhouses and machine-gun nests with their engineers during the siege.
tactics: 海戰與陸戰是兩套完全不同的戰術。海軍方面，自五月二十九日發現西班牙最新巡洋艦之後，美軍就在聖地牙哥港外拉起封鎖線，白天在莫羅城堡外海約六英里處成半圓形，入夜再悄悄收近。七月三日早上，桑普森帶旗艦與魚雷艇出海去西博尼同謝夫特會商，封鎖線西側一時出現缺口；西班牙分艦隊以七分鐘一艘的間隔出港，驅逐艦先行，主力分成三個縱隊直衝布魯克林號。接戰後美軍各艦拉成單縱隊，衣阿華號於九點三十分打出第一發，敵艦突圍訊號隨即升起；施萊在形勢險惡時下令倒轉迴旋，全隊轉向，形成以主力艦十二吋砲封住港口出口的交叉火網。西班牙艦隊一艘接一艘中彈起火，兩艘衝灘擱淺，其餘自沉。陸戰方面，六月二十四日在西博尼登陸，六月三十日在拉瓜西馬斯首次交戰；七月一日兵分兩路，第二師六千八百九十九人攻卡內伊，被五百一十四名西班牙正規軍與一百名地方武裝拖住近十二小時，攻方只有四門三點二吋野戰砲的砲兵連，加特林機槍分隊同時被抽調去聖胡安山；同日中央方向集中八千四百一十二人對五百二十一名西班牙守軍，先以砲火準備，再用短程衝鋒奪取聖胡安山與凱特山，志願騎兵團下馬後以二十分鐘攻上山脊，距離頂端尚有一百五十碼即發動突進，靠加特林機槍在山腳的掩護射擊與接近火力把人拉上壘線。當夜美軍不敢再攻，只加固壕線；七月三日海戰之後才形成對聖地牙哥的圍城線，直到七月十七日守軍投降。教訓很清楚：美軍騎兵操典仍以馬刀衝鋒與整齊縱隊為核心，志願兵改成下馬散兵前進先搶山頭；炮兵用黑火藥、射速慢，在毛瑟步槍面前幾乎沒有壓制力。
tacticsEn: Sea and land fought to two entirely different sets of tactics. At sea, from 29 May, when the newest Spanish cruiser was sighted, the Americans drew a blockade across the mouth of Santiago Bay, a semicircle about six miles seaward of the Morro by day and closing in quietly after dark. On the morning of 3 July Sampson left with his flagship and a torpedo boat for Siboney to meet Shafter, and the western end of the blockade line opened for a moment; the Spanish squadron steamed out at intervals of seven minutes a ship, the destroyers leading, the main body formed into three echelons and drove straight at the Brooklyn. Once contact was made the American ships formed in single line, the Iowa fired the first shot at half past nine and the signal for the enemy to break out was hoisted; in a moment of danger Schley ordered the retrograde turn and the line wheeled about, creating a cross fire that sealed the harbour mouth with the battleships' twelve inch guns. The Spanish ships were hit and set on fire one after another, two ran aground and the rest were scuttled. On land the Americans landed at Siboney on 24 June and first engaged at Las Guasimas on 30 June; on 1 July the attack went in two ways, Lawton's Second Division, 6,899 strong, hitting El Caney and being held there for nearly twelve hours by 514 Spanish regulars and about 100 armed locals, the attackers having only a battery of four 3.2 inch field guns because the Gatling detachment had been drawn off to San Juan Hill; at the same time the centre concentrated 8,412 men against 521 Spanish defenders, prepared with artillery and then took the heights of San Juan and Kettle Hill by short rushes, the volunteer cavalry fighting dismounted and reaching the ridge in twenty minutes, breaking into the charge a hundred and fifty yards from the top under the covering fire of the Gatling guns firing from the foot of the hill. That night the Americans did not attack again but strengthened their trench line; the siege lines around Santiago took shape only after the naval battle of 3 July, and the garrison did not surrender until 17 July. The lesson was plain: the American cavalry manual still made a charge of the sabre and a disciplined column the centre of gravity, and the volunteers simply dismounted and led with loose skirmishers to take the hill first; the artillery fired black powder at a slow rate and had almost no power to silence a Mauser.
data: 戰事自一八九八年四月二十一日起算，宣戰令追溯生效；實戰至八月十三日止，正式和約在十二月十日簽訂。兵力方面，美方全役動員三十萬人，實際部署七萬二千三百餘人；西班牙全境合計三十三萬九千七百餘人，其中古巴二十七萬八千餘人、波多黎各一萬零五人、菲律賓五萬一千三百餘人。傷亡方面，美軍作戰陣亡三百六十九名士兵、十名水手、六名陸戰隊員，受傷一千六百六十二人，被俘十一人，因病死亡二千零六十一人；西班牙方面陣亡二百名士兵、五百至六百名水手，受傷七百至八百人，俘虜四萬人，因病死亡一萬五千人。聖胡安山一役，美軍投入八千四百一十二人並配四挺加特林機槍，西班牙守軍五百二十一人；美軍陣亡一百四十四人、受傷一千零二十四人、失蹤七十二人，西班牙軍陣亡五十八人、受傷三百六十六人、被俘四十一人。卡內伊一役，美軍六千八百九十九人對五百一十四名正規軍加一百名地方武裝，美軍陣亡八十至二百零五人、受傷一千二百人，西班牙軍陣亡三十八人、受傷一百三十八人、被俘一百六十人。聖地牙哥海戰，美方五艘主力艦、兩艘裝甲巡洋艦與兩艘武裝快艇，對四艘裝甲巡洋艦加兩艘驅逐艦；美軍僅一人陣亡、一人受傷，西班牙軍三百四十三人陣亡、一百五十一人受傷、一千八百八十九人被俘，六艘艦全部覆沒。帕克中尉的加特林機槍在八分半鐘內打出一萬八千發。另有兩個早期數字：巡洋艦緬因號二月十五日在哈瓦那港爆炸，二百六十六名艦員陣亡；主力艦俄勒岡號單艦航行一萬四千五百海里，歷時六十六日。
dataEn: The war is counted from 21 April 1898, the date to which the declaration of war was made retroactive, and fighting ended on 13 August, with the formal peace treaty signed on 10 December. On strength, the United States mobilised 300,000 men and actually deployed 72,339 or thereabouts; Spain had 339,783 men in all, of whom 278,447 or more were in Cuba, 10,005 in Puerto Rico and 51,331 in the Philippines. On losses, the Americans had 369 soldiers, 10 sailors and 6 marines killed in action, 1,662 wounded, 11 taken prisoner and 2,061 dead of disease; the Spanish had 200 soldiers and 500 to 600 sailors killed, 700 to 800 wounded, 40,000 taken prisoner and 15,000 dead of disease. At San Juan Hill the Americans committed 8,412 men with four Gatling guns against 521 Spanish defenders, losing 144 killed, 1,024 wounded and 72 missing, while the Spanish lost 58 killed, 366 wounded and 41 captured. At El Caney 6,899 Americans faced 514 regulars and about 100 armed locals, the Americans losing 80 to 205 dead and 1,200 wounded, the Spanish 38 killed, 138 wounded and 160 captured. In the naval battle of Santiago de Cuba five American battleships, two armoured cruisers and two armed yachts went against four armoured cruisers and two destroyers; the Americans lost one man killed and one wounded, the Spanish 343 killed, 151 wounded and 1,889 captured, all six ships being lost. Parker's Gatling guns fired 18,000 rounds in eight and a half minutes. Two earlier figures belong to the same record: the protected cruiser Maine exploded in Havana harbour on 15 February with 266 of her men dead, and the battleship Oregon took sixty-six days to cover fourteen thousand five hundred nautical miles.
cause: 導火索由三條線交疊而成。最深的一條在古巴：一八九五年古巴獨立戰爭全面爆發，西班牙當局在韋勒指揮下推行集中營政策，把鄉村人口驅入營地，美國輿論對此極為不滿，而美資在糖、煙草與古巴港口的投資亦受威脅。外交上，一八九八年三月西班牙駐美公使杜威伊·德·洛姆致麥金利的私信在參議院被公開，信中貶低美國總統，被視為西班牙當局輕視美國的直接證據。海軍事件方面，巡洋艦緬因號二月十五日在哈瓦那港爆炸，二百六十六名艦員陣亡，事故原因至今未有定論，但輿論一律歸咎於西班牙。輿論方面，紐約日報與紐約世界報的黃色新聞把緬因號與西班牙暴行炒成全國議題，國會壓力遠超平時。政策上，麥金利與參議員提爾於四月二十日提出修正案，承認古巴獨立、要求西班牙撤軍，同時聲明美國無意吞併古巴；三月廿七日美方提出停火撤軍的最後通牒被拒，於是四月二十五日宣戰。菲律賓方面，阿吉納爾多領導的革命黨人向美國求援，希望由美國接管島嶼，兩個殖民地的反西班牙鬥爭因此併入同一場戰爭。西班牙召回塞韋拉率分艦隊赴加勒比，本身已顯示政府打算用艦隊保住帝國，談判空間更窄。
causeEn: The occasion was made of three lines crossing. The deepest lay in Cuba: the Cuban war of independence broke out in full in 1895, and under General Weyler the Spanish authorities carried out a reconcentration policy, driving the rural population into camps; American opinion was inflamed by it, and American investment in sugar, tobacco and the Cuban ports was likewise imperilled. In diplomacy, a private letter written in March 1898 by the Spanish minister in Washington, Dupuy de Lome, to President McKinley was read in the Senate, and its contempt for the American president was taken as direct evidence that Madrid was scornful of the United States. On the naval side the protected cruiser Maine exploded in Havana harbour on 15 February, killing 266 of her men; the cause has never been conclusively established, but the newspapers charged it to Spain. The press campaign, the New York Journal and the New York World, turned the Maine and alleged Spanish outrages into a national issue and pushed Congress far harder than usual. On policy, McKinley and Senator Teller introduced an amendment on 20 April recognising Cuban independence and demanding Spanish withdrawal while declaring that the United States had no intention of annexing Cuba; the American ultimatum of 27 March calling for an armistice and a withdrawal was rejected, and war was declared on 25 April. In the Philippines Aguinaldo's revolutionaries appealed to the United States to take over the islands, so that the anti-Spanish struggles of two colonies were folded into a single war. Spain's recall of Cervera with a squadron for the Caribbean showed that the government meant to hold the empire with the fleet, and narrowed the room for negotiation.
impact: 這場戰爭是美國由工業強國變成世界強國的分水嶺。西班牙在新大陸與亞洲的殖民體系解體：古巴名義上獨立而實際受美國軍事政府管治，波多黎各與關島成為美國領土，菲律賓由阿吉納爾多宣布成立共和國，隨即引發一八九九年起持續到一九〇二年的菲律賓對美戰爭；西班牙再無能力重建海外艦隊，國內也因戰敗與軍費失控而分裂成自由派與保守派的對立。美國這邊，海軍獲得空前地位，馬漢的制海權論成為國家戰略主流，俄勒岡號歸國後美國開始成規模建造主力艦，後來的白色艦隊巡洋全球；海軍同時取得關島、波多黎各、關塔那摩灣與馬尼拉灣的海外基地，加上古巴走廊，令美國可以用軍艦直接支援加勒比與東亞。陸軍方面，戰爭暴露了舊式黑火藥單發槍、缺乏機槍支援與後勤不足的代價，改革聲浪推動到統一更換新式栓動步槍；騎兵與志願兵制度也令大批州民兵湧進軍中，產生命中騎兵團那樣的政治神話。西奧多·羅斯福靠聖胡安山一役走紅，返國競選州長得勝，兩年後做副總統，再隔一年入主白宮。戰後美國把利益伸入加勒比與太平洋，羅斯福推論隨後出台，中美洲與加勒比多次出現美軍干預，帝國路線由此成形。西班牙此後再無力在歐洲以外承擔大國責任，帝國崩解的代價轉化為國內政治危機，軍備與財政改革成為往後二十年西班牙政治的主線。
impactEn: The war was the watershed that turned the United States from an industrial power into a world power. Spain's colonial system in the New World and in Asia came apart: Cuba was independent in name but governed under United States military administration, Puerto Rico and Guam became American territory, and in the Philippines Aguinaldo proclaimed a republic, which immediately opened into the Philippine-American War that ran from 1899 to 1902; Spain could never rebuild an overseas fleet, and at home defeat and runaway war costs split the country between Liberals and Conservatives. In the United States the navy acquired an unrivalled position, Alfred Thayer Mahan's argument for sea power became national strategy, and after Oregon returned the navy began building battleships in series, the later white fleet cruising the globe; the navy also gained overseas bases at Guam, Puerto Rico, Guantanamo Bay and Manila Bay, and with Cuba on the flank this allowed the United States to support the Caribbean and East Asia with warships directly. On the army side the war exposed the cost of old black powder single-shot rifles, of a lack of machine-gun support and of thin logistics, and the pressure for reform carried through to the standardisation of new bolt-action rifles; the cavalry and volunteer system also drew crowds of state militia into the ranks and produced a political legend of the kind the rough riders embodied. Theodore Roosevelt made his name at San Juan Hill, won the governorship of New York on his return, became vice president two years later and entered the White House the year after that. American interests afterwards reached into the Caribbean and the Pacific, the Roosevelt Corollary followed, and United States intervention appeared again and again in Central America and the Caribbean, so that the line of empire took shape. Spain could no longer shoulder great power responsibilities outside Europe, and the cost of the collapse of the empire turned into a domestic political crisis, with army reform and fiscal reform standing at the centre of Spanish politics for the next twenty years.
result: 七月十七日，何塞·托拉爾率聖地牙哥守軍投降；七月三日海戰之後西班牙加勒比分艦隊全滅，港內守軍的補給線斷絕，古巴各地據點只能陸續繳械，遠征軍再也得不到成建制的增援與補給。八月十二日美西簽署停戰協議，戰鬥實際停止；八月十三日美軍在菲律賓革命黨人配合下進入馬尼拉。正式收尾的文件是十二月十日在巴黎簽訂的《巴黎條約》：西班牙放棄對古巴的主權，將波多黎各、關島與菲律賓割讓給美國，款項二千萬美元；美國參議院於一八九九年二月六日以五十四票對四十二票批准，古巴條約同年四月十一日生效，古巴自一八九八年六月十七日起置於美國軍事政府管治之下，到一九〇二年五月二十日才正式獨立，並附帶不得與外國結盟、保留美軍介入權等限制；關塔那摩灣則以永久租約形式交予美國。戰果中最實在的一項不在條文，而在人數與物資：西班牙在古巴的二十七萬餘名作戰單位隨守軍投降或被俘，全役約四萬人淪為俘虜，一萬五千人死於疾病，帝國在加勒比的陸海軍骨幹就此斷裂。戰爭的爛尾也留了下來：菲律賓割讓令革命軍與美軍由盟友變成敵人，菲律賓對美戰爭由一八九九年打到一九〇二年；古巴雖獲獨立而要靠美國駐軍維持秩序；西班牙則要用整整一代人處理帝國崩解帶來的財政與軍備難題。
resultEn: On 17 July Jose Toral surrendered the garrison of Santiago; after the naval battle of 3 July the Spanish Caribbean squadron was destroyed, the sea supply of the garrison was cut and the Spanish positions in Cuba could only surrender piecemeal, with no more organised reinforcement or supply reaching the Spanish army. On 12 August the two governments signed the protocol ending hostilities and the fighting actually stopped; on 13 August the Americans entered Manila with the help of the Philippine revolutionaries. The document that formally closed the war was the Treaty of Paris, signed in Paris on 10 December: Spain renounced sovereignty over Cuba and ceded Puerto Rico, Guam and the Philippines to the United States for twenty million dollars; the United States Senate approved it on 6 February 1899 by 54 votes to 42, and the Cuban articles entered into force on 11 April of that year, Cuba having been under United States military administration since 17 June 1898 and not becoming formally independent until 20 May 1902, with restrictions forbidding alliances with foreign powers and reserving a right of American intervention; Guantanamo Bay was leased to the United States in perpetuity. The most solid of the results lay not in the clauses but in men and material: the 278,000-odd Spanish troops in Cuba surrendered or were taken prisoner with the garrison, about 40,000 men were captured over the war and 15,000 died of disease, and the spine of Spain's Caribbean army and navy was broken. The war also left unfinished business behind: the cession of the Philippines turned the revolutionaries from allies of the Americans into their enemies, and the Philippine-American War ran from 1899 to 1902; Cuba obtained independence only while relying on American troops to hold order; and Spain needed a full generation to work through the financial and military consequences of the empire's collapse.
